name: Rich Text Section
summary: Passive bounded narrative section with an optional visible title, required target-owned semantic body, intrinsic containment, and zero neutral runtime.

anatomy.name: root
anatomy.description: Native thematic section when a visible title can name it; otherwise a generic div.

anatomy.name: title
anatomy.description: Optional non-empty visible contextual heading whose target-unique id names the section root.

anatomy.name: body
anatomy.description: Required non-empty target-owned semantic narrative body.

variants.name: default
variants.description: One bounded narrative presentation; measure, rhythm, element styling and responsive behavior remain private composition.

sizes.name: default
sizes.description: One semantic title/body scale whose native heading rank remains target-owned.

states.name: linkFocusVisible
states.description: Visible keyboard focus on target-owned native links.

behavior.name: conditionalRoot
behavior.description: A non-empty visible title creates and names a native thematic section through a target-unique id; without a title targets use a generic div rather than an unnamed section or article.

behavior.name: requiredBody
behavior.description: Missing or empty required semantic body content omits the complete component instead of rendering an empty shell.

behavior.name: semanticContent
behavior.description: Targets preserve meaningful paragraphs, contextual headings, ordered and unordered lists, emphasis, quotations and citations, figures and captions, images, and links rather than flattening supplied content into decorative containers.

behavior.name: linkNavigation
behavior.description: Links remain descriptive native anchors with target-owned destinations, history, external-link policy, and activation.

behavior.name: contentResilience
behavior.description: Short, long, empty, localized, RTL, unbroken, zoomed, and media-rich target content remains in authored order and within the component container without viewport-only markup.

behavior.name: passiveRuntime
behavior.description: Rich Text Section owns no controlled or uncontrolled state, event, listener, observer, request, timer, parser, sanitizer, layout read, custom element, asset, authored motion, or neutral runtime.

properties.name: title
properties.unsetBehavior: Omit the title and render a generic root without aria-labelledby.
properties.description: Optional non-empty visible contextual heading; targets choose its native heading rank and unique id.

properties.name: body
properties.unsetBehavior: Omit the complete component when no non-empty semantic body is supplied.
properties.description: Required non-empty target-owned semantic narrative content; targets own source trust, sanitization, parsing, markup and publishing.

accessibility: Render a native section only when a non-empty visible contextual title can name it; otherwise use a generic div and never default to an autonomous article semantic.
Preserve logical target-owned heading order and native semantics for paragraphs, lists, emphasis, quotations, citations, figures, captions, links, and image alternatives.
Omit the complete component when the required semantic body is absent and omit the optional title without leaving empty nodes or naming attributes.
Keep native link purpose, destination, activation, persistent underline and visible keyboard focus; do not make passive content focusable.
Keep text and media contained through narrow widths, localization, RTL, zoom, 200 percent text, forced colors, and user styles without component JavaScript or authored motion.

web.notes: Implemented in components/css/sections.css with conditional native root semantics supplied by targets.

shopify.notes: Maps localized optional heading and required Shopify richtext settings to canonical classes with strict empty omission and zero component runtime.
